# anthropic_workspaces (Data Source)

Lists workspaces in the organization. Requires `admin_api_key` or `oauth_token`. The default workspace is not returned by the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_workspaces" "all" {
  include_archived = false
}

output "workspace_names" {
  value = data.anthropic_workspaces.all.workspaces[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_archived` (Boolean) Include archived workspaces. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `workspaces` (Attributes List) Workspaces. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspaces))

<a id="nestedatt--workspaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workspaces`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_inference_geos` (List of String) Allowed inference geographies; null when unrestricted.
- `archived_at` (String) Archive timestamp; null while live.
- `compartment_id` (String) Encryption compartment id.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `default_inference_geo` (String) Default inference geography.
- `display_color` (String) Hex color.
- `external_key_id` (String) Attached customer-managed encryption key id, if any.
- `id` (String) Workspace id.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags.
- `workspace_geo` (String) Workspace data geography.
